title: Let Him Cook
blurb: 'Let him cook!' — the internet's plea to not interrupt someone mid-brilliance. Whether the person is actually cooking or catastrophically failing is beside the point; the phrase demands you find out. It became the default hype comment on everything from gameplay to unhinged Twitter threads. Sometimes he was, in fact, not cooking. We let him anyway.
origin: The viral 'let him cook' hype phrase from streaming and sports culture.
